Instituto Técnico do Norte is requesting temporary access to hourly data from one installation to diagnose a connector discrepancy. The general policy requires at least three meters per aggregate, so the request constitutes an exception.

The purpose is limited to technical diagnosis, and the requested period is forty-eight hours. The proposal is to authorize only synthetic data reproducing the observed pattern. If that is insufficient, a four-hour real sample could be enabled without an installation identifier and through a secure space with no download.

The exception requires approval from privacy and the dataset owner. Bruno may not retain the data after the incident is closed. Andrés will document the decision, and Sergio will verify deletion. Access to a complete series from one installation will not be approved because it could reveal consumption habits.
